headline: Delta Manufacturing declares financial results for Q2 FY27
summary: Delta Manufacturing Limited has reported its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, following a board meeting. The company filed these routine figures with the stock exchange as part of its mandatory disclosure requirements. Indian retail investors tracking the company can review the earnings statement on the exchange to assess its quarterly financial performance.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the company's recent operational performance.
